meta.title: Web design in Stuttgart: websites & online booking – {brand.full}
meta.description: Web design from Stuttgart: websites, online booking and web apps that turn visitors into customers – with care and hosting in Germany.
meta.socialAlt: {brand.full} – Web design and development in Stuttgart

hero.lead: I design and build websites and online booking for businesses in and around Stuttgart – so your quality shows online, enquiries come more easily and routine work disappears.

services.lead: From your first website to online booking and care after launch: design and technology from one source – always focused on who uses your site and what they want to get done.
services.extra: Beyond that: interactive prototypes as well as 3D and Unity applications – just ask.

pageLabels.ctaText: Tell me briefly what it is about – I will reply by email with a few first questions.

process.lead: Four steps from your first message to launch – with clear check-ins between each stage and one point of contact from start to finish.

steps.title: Getting to know you
steps.text: You briefly describe your project. I reply by email and we clarify goals, audience and scope in an intro call.

steps.title: Concept & quote
steps.text: I outline structure and content and suggest a suitable scope. Based on that, you receive a quote.

steps.title: Design & build
steps.text: I design and develop in stages and agree on each milestone with you before moving on.

steps.title: Launch & handover
steps.text: After testing together, everything goes live. You receive all access details, the website belongs entirely to you – and on request I take care of hosting and updates afterwards.

effortItems: Scope: number of pages and amount of content
Whether copy and images already exist
Features such as online booking, forms or a customer area
process.effortNote: After our first conversation, you receive a quote tailored to your project.

about.lead: Behind {brand.full} is me, Moritz Fieler – UX designer and front-end developer in Stuttgart, Germany. You talk to me from the first conversation until after launch, in person or by video.
about.personBio: Several years of UX design at Mercedes-Benz – from the MBUX infotainment system to connected e-mobility – after studying Mobile Media at Stuttgart Media University. Today I bring that experience to projects for businesses in the region: understand people, reduce complexity, test results with users.

items.title: One point of contact
items.text: You talk to me from the first conversation until after launch – no hand-offs, no lost messages.

items.title: Design and code from one source
items.text: What I design, I build myself. Nothing gets lost between agency and developers.

items.title: Tested, not guessed
items.text: I test designs with people from your target group before serious money goes into building.

items.title: Accessible and privacy-friendly
items.text: Websites to WCAG standards, hosted in Germany – and without cookie banners where none are needed.

projects.lead: How I work, in practice – from a Pilates studio in Stuttgart to concepts with Mercedes-AMG.
